question: Which of the following museums is located in Cuttack?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Netaji Birth Place Museum.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Netaji **Birth Place** Museum is Located in **Oriya Bazaar in the city of Cuttack**.
 
• **Janakinath Bhawan** is the place where Netaji used to live and now has been converted into a museum.
 
• Jankinath Bhavan was converted into a museum in the** year 2007.**
 
• Cuttack is a city in the eastern Indian state of** Odisha.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Museum **is located in **New Delhi.**
 
• **Indian Museum** is Located in **West Bengal(Kolkata).**
 
• **Salar Jung Museum** is located in **Hyderabad(Telangana).**
 
• The **largest** Museum in India is the **Indian Museum, Kolkata**.
 
• Central Museum Authority is located in** New Delhi.**
 
• The biggest museum in the world is the **British Museum (London).**
